title: Pan-Seared Gyoza with Jovial Dutch Sauce
description: A crispy pan-seared gyoza dish served with a rich and flavorful jovial dutch sauce. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Gyoza (pan-seared)
ingredients.notes: Available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Fish Sauce
ingredients.notes: For added umami flavor in the sauce

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of jovial olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the gyoza to the skillet and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the gyoza from the skillet and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of jovial olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the dutch mustard, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the skillet.
Whisk the sauce until it's smooth and bubbly, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the pan-seared gyoza to the skillet and toss with the sauce until coated.
Transfer the gyoza to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
